preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have authorized privileges

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the blacklistAddress function to blacklist the pair address (or all user addresses), effectively stopping all transactions. Alternatively, set tradingOpen to false if such a function exists (though not shown in provided code, similar owner-controlled functions exist). The vulnerability allows owner to disable trading for all users while maintaining their own ability to transact.
